Meanwhile, continue to scan the area.''"<br />"''Yes, Captain Needa.|Needa's request to the Imperial officer after failing to capture the ''Millennium Falcon''|audio=Needa-ShuttleReady.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and was an '''officer''' by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the individual was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa's]] [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]] aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], attached to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], the ''Avenger'' aided Death [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron's]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide search for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] headquarters, which led to the discovery of a [[Echo Base/Legends|hidden base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Following the subsequent [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the ''Avenger'' took part in the pursuit of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. When the pursuit led to the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] stood alongside Needa at the [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] of the ''Avenger''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]]. After the ''Falcon'' seemingly disappeared from the ''Avenger''{{'s}} sight, Needa requested the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] prepare a [[TIE/sh VIP shuttle]] to take him to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], where the captain would personally apologize to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] for his failure.

==Biography==
{{Quote|No ship that small has a cloaking device.|Needa, to the Imperial officer, while pondering the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} whereabouts|audio=Needa-NoShip.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="BTM" /> was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="ESB" /> During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> the individual served<ref name="ESB" /> as the [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]]<ref name="ESB junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]], the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']],<ref name="ESB" /> attached to the Imperial [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

[[File:YouHaveToBeKidding-ESB.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Imperial officer alongside Captain Needa on the bridge of the ''Avenger'' during the pursuit of the ''Millennium Falcon'']]
In that same year,<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] of Death [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] deployed [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in search of the Alliance's headquarters. The ''Avenger'' was part of the search, and sent [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] to the [[Tokmia system/Legends|Tokmia]] and [[Allyuen system/Legends|Allyuen systems]] alongside another ''Imperial II''-class Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]], the ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]''. Death Squadron was near the [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet system]]<ref name="Atlas" /> at the [[Time/Legends|time]] one of the ''Stalker''{{'s}} probe [[Droid/Legends|droids]]<ref name="Stalker CCG">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=''Stalker''}}</ref> discovered the Alliance's [[Echo Base/Legends|hidden base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="ESB" /> Death Squadron made a series of jumps through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in order to reach the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]],<ref name="Atlas" /> resulting in the subsequent [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. During the battle, the Imperial [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] made a [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground assault]] on the planet while the Star Destroyers of Death Squadron waited to intercept Alliance [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]] and other Rebel ships evacuating the planet.<ref name="ESB" /> The ''Avenger'' performed well during the battle, where it attacked evacuating Alliance [[Transport/Legends|transports]].<ref name="Needa Encyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|captain-needa|Captain Needa}}</ref> Following the battle, which resulted in an Imperial victory and the Alliance being forced to evacuate their headquarters, the Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was stationed on the ''Avenger''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]] when the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was charged with pursuing the fugitive [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] through the Hoth [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="ESB" />

During the pursuit of the ''Millennium Falcon'', the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] managed to outmaneuver the ''Avenger'', causing it to almost collide with another pursuing Star Destroyer. The ''Avenger'' chased the ''Falcon'' into the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]], where the Star Destroyer lost track of the fugitive Alliance [[Starship/Legends|ship]] after its crew unknowingly took cover in the mouth of a [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]] housed in one of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].<ref name="ESB" /> Upon [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader's command, the ''Avenger'' traveled into the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] to search for the ''Falcon'', where it suffered significant damage.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> Eventually, the ''Millennium Falcon'' reappeared, and the ''Avenger'' spotted the ship during its attempted escape. Needa had a priority signal sent to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], with the message that the ''Falcon'' was about to be captured.<ref name="ESB" />

The Imperial officer was standing next to Needa at the [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] of the ''Avenger''{{'s}} bridge when the pursuit of the ''Falcon'' reached the neighboring [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]]. The freighter moved into what Needa assumed was attack position, and charged the bridge<ref name="ESB" /> as alarms were set off throughout the ''Avenger''.<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> The Imperial officer, Needa and the rest of the command crew dove for cover before the ''Falcon'' veered away at the last moment, and seemingly disappeared from the Star Destroyer's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Unbeknownst to Needa and his crew, the ''Millennium Falcon'' simply landed on a blind spot of the ''Avenger''{{'s}} conning tower. Needa ordered the Imperial officer to track the ship, believing it might come for another pass,<ref name="ESB" /> before the ''Avenger''{{'s}} logistics officer, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Nemet/Legends|Nemet]], reported that the ''Falcon'' was no longer on the Star Destroyer's sensors, and said there was no trace of the ship.<ref name="BTM" /> [[Standard second|Seconds]] later,<ref name="ESB" /> the ''Avenger''{{'s}} [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]], [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]], reported that [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader demanded an update on the pursuit of the ''Falcon''.<ref name="BTM" /> Needa ordered the Imperial officer to prepare a [[TIE/sh VIP shuttle]] for his visit to the ''Executor'', where he would take full responsibility for the loss and apologize to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord. He gave the officer one last request to continue searching the area for the ''Falcon''&mdash;again to no avail, before traveling to the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] to meet with Vader, where the Dark Lord [[Death/Legends|executed]] the captain for his failure.<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
The Imperial officer took cover along with Captain Needa and the rest of the command crew when the ''Millennium Falcon'' flew toward the ''Avenger''{{'s}} bridge. The officer was fair-skinned and had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
The first officer wore the standard-issue [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]] while serving aboard the ''Avenger''{{'s}} bridge<ref name="ESB" /> in 3 ABY.<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial officer first appeared in ''[[The Empire Strikes Back Storybook]]'', released in [[April]] [[1980]],<ref name="ESB storybook">''[[The Empire Strikes Back Storybook]]''</ref> shortly before the actual film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], and was portrayed by an uncredited extra, standing on the ''Avenger''{{'s}} command bridge alongside Captain Needa during the Hoth campaign.<ref name="ESB" /> The film was released [[May 21]] of that year,<ref name="Empire Turns 40">{{ThisWeek|6UccH037VQ0|The Empire Strikes Back Turns 40, Queen's Peril Gets a Voice, and More!|sw_url=video/the-empire-strikes-back-turns-40-queen-s-peril-gets-a-voice-and-more}}</ref> and the scenes on the bridge of the ''Avenger'' were shot on Stage 5 at [[Elstree Studios]] at some point between [[April 24]] and [[May 2]], [[1979]].<ref name="365Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref>

While not credited in the film itself,<ref name="ESB" /> actor [[Mike Reynell]], listed as a "[[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]]" in a [[:File:CallSheet35.png|film callsheet]],<ref name="CALLSHEET35">[[:File:CallSheet35.png|''The Empire Strikes Back'' Call Sheet Number 35]]</ref> has been credited as playing the role by the fan website [https://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman].<ref name="Aveleyman">{{WebCite|url=https://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=93911|text=Mike Reynell|work=[https://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman - Film]|archivedate=20220613151002}}</ref> The officer is not featured in the film's [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|novelization]], in which it is unclear who it is to whom Needa is speaking when he gives the request to prepare his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] for his rendezvous with Darth Vader.<ref name="ESB novel" />

===Inconsistencies===
{{Quote|We're going to collide!|The Imperial officer's line from the comic ''Star Wars'' (1977) 42|<ref name="Marvel">[[Star Wars (1977) 42|''Star Wars'' (1977) 42]]</ref>}}
In the [[December 1]], 1980<ref name="Marvel date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53832/star_wars_1977_42|text=Star Wars (1977) #42}}</ref> [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Star Wars (1977) 42|''Star Wars'' (1977) 42]], the Imperial officer has the line "We're going to collide!" when the ''Millennium Falcon'' is charging the ''Avenger''{{'s}} bridge,<ref name="Marvel" /> a line given to Commander Nemet in the same scene of the novelization.<ref name="ESB novel" /> ''The Empire Strikes Back Storybook'' gives the line instead to Captain Needa.<ref name="ESB storybook" /> This article assumes Nemet's line from the novel is the [[canon]] version of events.
